page_title: LIL 2-1 TOU | Lille v Toulouse 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Clement Turpin has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Tiago Santos (Lille) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+5' Toulouse have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
90+3' Frank Magri (Toulouse) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Clement Turpin ignores the protests.
90+2' Jonathan David (Lille) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

90' Toulouse slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
88' A corner kick by Toulouse is thwarted by the well prepared Lucas Chevalier (Lille).
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Toulouse comes to nothing. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
86' The resulting set piece from Toulouse is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
86' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) makes a weak connection with the corner kick, and his close-range header is easily blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Toulouse will take a corner.
85' Toulouse earn a corner.
84' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Cristian Casseres is replaced by Miha Zajc (Toulouse).
84' Substitution. Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) on for Rasmus Nicolaisen.

83' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Toulouse are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
82' Angel Gomes (Lille) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
81' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Edon Zhegrova and he is replaced by Remy Cabella (Lille).
79' Total attempts – 11:6.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) comes onto the pitch for Djibril Sidibe.
76' Referee Clement Turpin points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Lille players celebrate.
74' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Clement Turpin wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
72' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) has a goal ruled out for offside!
72' 2 - 1 GOAL! Mitchel Bakker (Lille) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Guillaume Restes, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 2:1.
71' Toulouse are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
70' Wonderful movement by Lille. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
67' Gabriel Gudmundsson goes off the pitch and Mitchel Bakker (Lille) comes on.
66' Today's match ends for Osame Sahraoui who will be replaced by Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille).

64' Joshua King will be replaced by Frank Magri (Toulouse).

60' 2:2 – the corner kicks stats.

56' Benjamin Andre (Lille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Clement Turpin saw the whole situation.

54' Lille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
52' Lille are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. Lille have a corner.
52' The ball possession at the moment is 61:39.

49' Jonathan David (Lille) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.

37' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
34' The corner is swung in but Toulouse can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
32' Lille are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

27' Jonathan David (Lille) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Lille force a corner. They send men into the box.
26' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.

23' What an opportunity! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post! The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
21' Wonderful movement by Lille. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

19' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
16' Toulouse couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Lucas Chevalier (Lille) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
15' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Alexsandro (Lille) for a tough tackle.
